2608.13492.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling - Full Technical Report (v1.1)
2608.13492.paper_summary: This report presents an improved version of AlayaWorld. While the backbone architecture, chunk-wise autoregressive generation scheme, and training data remain unchanged from the previous release, we substantially revise how conditioning signals are represented and integrated into the model. The new design is guided by a simple principle: conditioning signals should match the generated content as closely as possible in both latent representation and temporal structure. To this end, we make two major changes. First, we replace the previous depth-warping-based spatial memory with a streaming 3D point-cache renderer. Second, we redesign the conditioning pipeline so that visual conditions are encoded in the same causal-VAE latent space, with temporal statistics consistent with those of the generated video. Concretely, the new version introduces six modifications: (1) replacing static-frame image conditioning with motion-aware latent conditioning; (2) causally encoding re-rendered spatial memory as a continuous sequence; (3) aligning the temporal-memory window in pixel space; (4) adopting hard memory dropout that removes memory tokens rather than zeroing them; (5) unifying the VAE encoding and decoding protocol across training and inference; and (6) removing the camera AdaLN branch, such that viewpoint control is provided entirely through the re-rendered spatial condition.
2608.13492.paper_summary_zh: 這份報告呈現了 AlayaWorld 的改進版本。雖然骨幹架構、逐塊自回歸生成方案和訓練數據與之前的版本保持不變，但我們對條件信號的表示和整合方式進行了 substantial 的修訂。新設計遵循一個簡單的原則：條件信號應在潛在表示和時間結構上與生成內容儘可能匹配。為此，我們進行了兩個主要的改變。首先，我們用流式 3D 點緩存渲染器替換了之前基於深度扭曲的空間記憶。其次，我們重新設計了條件管道，使得視覺條件在相同的因果 VAE 潛在空間中編碼，並且時間統計與生成視頻的一致。具體而言，新版本引入了六項修改：(1) 用運動感知潛在條件替換靜態幀圖像條件；(2) 將重新渲染的空間記憶因果編碼為連續序列；(3) 在像素空間中對齊時間記憶窗口；(4) 採用硬記憶丟棄，移除記憶標記而不是將其歸零；(5) 統一訓練和推理中的 VAE 編碼和解碼協議；以及 (6) 移除相機 AdaLN 分支，使得視點控制完全通過重新渲染的空間條件提供。
